Two Teens Die in Police Pursuit Crash in Coweta County

Two teenagers were killed and one was seriously injured following a car crash that occurred during a police pursuit in Coweta County. A man has been accused of causing the two deaths while fleeing police and reportedly cried in court. He has been charged in connection with the incident.
